summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting a September 29, 2026 Credit Agreement with Citibank as administrative agent for a $3.3 billion senior term loan facility to help fund the previously announced acquisition of EPC Power Corp. and related assets. The facility was undrawn at closing, permits a single advance during the availability period, matures 364 days after funding, prices at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a ratings-based margin, and carries a 4.50x Debt/EBITDA and 3.00x interest coverage covenant. Watch EPC deal timing, drawdown, and leverage headroom.
